title: Tenant 80 Bosnia and Herzegovina: status 706 -> 707 not configured; developers force it manually
root_cause: Tenant 80 Bosnia and Herzegovina: status 706 (Cancelled by Call Center) -> 707 (New Application) is NOT configured in Catalog.StatusStep, so the application refuses it; in 2 resolved tickets (2026-02-13 .. 2026-04-09) the work order status was nevertheless changed in Log.WorkOrderJsonLog without an Operation.WorkOrderGpsInfo history row, i.e. most likely forced directly in the database by a developer.
fix_steps: Confirm in status_step_check that 706 -> 707 is missing for the tenant (IsRequestedTarget = 0).

Decide with the business whether the transition should be allowed; if yes add the Catalog.StatusStep row (config change), if it is a deliberate restriction explain it to the requester instead of forcing the status.
Check wo_field_changes: a status change without a history row and with UpdateUserId unchanged confirms the manual fix.
If the app refuses for another reason, investigate why the application flow fails (see wo_status_transition_check).
